title: CartItem
description: A single line item in the cart, as exposed by the CartController state and used in cart action payloads.

productId.description: The unique product identifier. Corresponds to the Product's permanentid field.

name.description: The display name of the product at the time it was added to the cart.

price.description: The non-negative unit price at the time the item was added, in the session currency.

quantity.description: The number of units of this product in the cart.
